topic: Request for AWS credentials and data access
summary_markdown: Someone requested assistance with accessing Japanese GPS data provided by DCM, which is stored in AWS S3. To proceed, the following details were required: End point ID (e.g., "vpce-XXXX") and IAM role ARN (e.g., "arn:aws:iam::XXXX"). [me] offered to investigate if 'Толик' was unavailable.
action_items: Provide the AWS S3 access details (End point ID and I AM roll ARN) for the Japanese GPS data.
